Hardware qualification
M720q is a candidate: one M.2 SSD slot + one SATA 2.5-inch bay. CPU, RAM, disks, budget and UPS remain open.

Talos, Cilium and Ceph remain under review. Three physical nodes are a target, not proof of HA; shared power and network still matter.
